livingCosts.notes: University of Sydney 'General living costs' table (monthly AUD, figures from the Study Australia cost-of-living calculator; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints. Housing: accommodation $980-$3,500. Food: food and groceries $1,000-$2,500. Transport: $130-$800. Personal: mobile phone $30-$100 + lifestyle $350-$650 + gym $70-$100. The page also cites the older Home Affairs visa minimum of $24,505/yr.
